children.prompt: Find the size of each interior angle of the pentagon $ABCDE$.

answer.worked:
A pentagon can be divided into three triangles, so its interior angle sum is $3\times180^\circ=540^\circ$. All five interior angles are equal.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Each interior angle}&=\frac{540^\circ}{5}\\\text{Each interior angle}&=108^\circ\end{align*}$$

answer.short:
$\alpha=72^\circ$, $\beta=72^\circ$, $\gamma=36^\circ$.

Use supplementary angles at $B$ and $C$, then the angle sum of $\triangle BCZ$.
answer.worked:
Adjacent angles on a straight line are supplementary.

$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=180^\circ-108^\circ\\\alpha&=72^\circ\\\beta&=180^\circ-108^\circ\\\beta&=72^\circ\end{align*}$$

The angles of $\triangle BCZ$ sum to $180^\circ$.

$$\begin{align*}\gamma&=180^\circ-72^\circ-72^\circ\\\gamma&=36^\circ\end{align*}$$
